scope: Additive Home Village TH18 Super Miner integration. All earlier frozen references, including the historical non-enabling mechanics audit, remain unmodified.
game_version: The immutable upstream payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. Goblins Farm reports values extracted from client build 18.400.21 on 2026-08-26. The community mechanics table is current but does not identify a client build.

sources.title: December Update
sources.limitations: The launch note establishes any-building priority, single-target ground-only attacks, 24 housing space, movement speed 32, increasing attack damage and a bomb left on death. It does not publish cadence, range, numerical ramp stages, bomb damage or radius, underground timing, reset conditions, or a current client build.

sources.title: Super Miner - Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.limitations: The page reports data read from Supercell game files and identifies its build. It supplies current L7-L12 hitpoints and initial DPS plus 24 housing space, 0.25-second cadence and 0.6-tile range. It does not tabulate later damage stages, death damage, blast radius or underground lifecycle.

sources.title: Super Miner
sources.limitations: The current table supplies L7-L12 initial, 1.5-second and 3-second DPS plus death damage. Its summary supplies the two-tile blast, enemy-ground and building target filter, and Miner-like underground defense immunity. The page does not identify a capture build, exact first-hit or stage boundary ordering, reset conditions, underground transition timing, trap behavior, pathing or bomb delay.

support.note: Core uses the shared deterministic burrow, damage-ramp and death-explosion systems. The official launch establishes the qualitative mechanics. Exact level values are split between dated secondary game files and a current version-unknown table.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only data with a historical non-enabling mechanics audit.
changed_values.replacement: L7-L12 materialize through one shared Core implementation with sourced initial, 1.5-second and 3-second damage stages, Miner-like underground movement and a two-tile enemy-ground death blast.
changed_values.justification: Supercell establishes the mechanic family. A dated game-file table provides current base values and a version-unknown secondary table supplies the remaining numerical lifecycle contract. The historical audit stays preserved and is superseded only for the newly evidenced fields.

known_uncertainties: The full damage-stage table, blast damage and two-tile ground-only filter come from a current secondary page without a client build. They are not represented as primary fidelity.

Public material does not state whether the first strike is at initial damage, the exact inclusive boundary at 1.5 and 3 seconds, or all reset conditions. Core follows the existing serialized target-lock stage rule and records this as a replaceable interpretation.

The public description establishes Miner-like underground defense immunity but not burrow or reappearance timing, target retention, pathfinding, collision, trap activation or interaction with spells. Core reuses the ordinary Miner route and does not claim those details as verified.

The death bomb's delay, detonation position and destruction ordering are unpublished. Core applies its source-backed payload immediately at the destroyed entity position through the existing deterministic death-damage route.
The repository has a public Super Miner image path, but its origin and level-specific visual fidelity remain unverified. It is not claimed asset-complete.
conclusion: Super Miner is executable through the same Core, CLI, Viewer and RL paths with dated and version-unknown secondary numerical evidence. It remains partial until the documented timing, underground lifecycle, bomb timing and source-verified assets are available.
